<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class PatientConsultationRequestTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testSymptomCodeDeletionWithUsage()
    {
        $this->expectException(\Exception::class);
        $this->expectMessageContaining('Symptom Code used, cannot be deleted');
        
        // Simulate a Patient Consultation Request with a used Symptom Code
        $consultationRequest = new PatientConsultationRequest(['symptomCode' => 'CODE_IN_USE']);
        
        // Attempt to delete the Symptom Code
        $consultationRequest->deleteSymptomCode();
    }
}

public function testSystemDeploymentOnHeroku()
{
    // Assuming there's a method to check the deployment platform
    $this->assertTrue(PlatformDetector::isDeployedOn('Heroku'));
}

public function testStakeholdersLogin()
{
    // Simulate a stakeholder login
    $this->loginAsStakeholder();
    
    // Check if the stakeholder can access the Virtual Clinic website
    $this->assertEquals('https://yourclinic.herokuapp.com/');
}

public function testProcessorCapability()
{
    $this->assertTrue(PHP_MAJOR_VERSION >= 4);
}

public function testHarddriveSpaceSufficient()
{
    // Assuming there's a method to check available harddrive space
    $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(100, getAvailableHarddriveSpace());
}

public function testMinimumRAMSufficient()
{
    $this->assertGreaterEqual(128, memory_get_usage());
}

public function testDatabaseSpaceSufficient()
{
    $this->assertGreaterEqual(1, getDatabaseSpace());
}

public function testMinimumRamSufficient()
{
    $this->assertGreaterEqual(2, memory_get_usage());
}
}
